# ChIP-seq Simulation

## Goal

Simulate TF, histone-mark, or nucleosome enrichment around annotations such as
promoters, enhancers, silencers, genes, and TSSs. `simitall` can produce peak
truth, matched inputs, read FASTQs, differential-binding truth, and figures.

## Experimental Design

- Specify the target type and expected binding logic.
- Include matched input controls and biological replicates.
- State fragment-length distribution, read depth, duplicate behavior, and
  whether different conditions alter occupancy.
- Keep the annotation source and coordinate convention with the peak truth.

## QC

- Fraction of reads in peaks, enrichment against input, duplicate rate, and
  coverage around expected regulatory features.
- Peak precision and recall against simulation truth.
- Differential-binding sensitivity and false discoveries when conditions are
  simulated.

## Limits

ChIP-seq read density is not direct molecular occupancy. Peak calls depend on
background, fragment model, depth, mappability, and the caller.
